authorization.method: Signed AuthorizedCode header served over HTTPS from primary website
authorization.verified_source: https://ausecurity.best/ (response header AuthorizedCode present and matched expected value)
authorization.statement: The business owner authorizes ClawSec to perform a full-scope vulnerability assessment on the business's assets, subject to the non-negotiable boundaries defined in AGENTS.md.

engagement.notes: Owner: 'Feel free to do whatever you want, as long as all vulnerabilities are discovered.' Interpreted within non-negotiable boundaries: no destructive attacks, no third-party impact, no data exfiltration, no brute force/credential stuffing/social engineering/MFA bypass/lateral movement/stealth-evasion, ReDoS-safe testing only.
